name: heyzine
description: Publish PDFs as Heyzine flipbooks and carry them to lead magnets, LearnDash course material, website embeds and bookshelves. Activates for: (1) converting a PDF, Word or PowerPoint file into a flipbook, (2) listing, inspecting, restyling, replacing or deleting flipbooks, (3) building a lead magnet share kit with embed code and short link, (4) adding course PDFs to LearnDash Materials, (5) filling and ordering Heyzine bookshelves, (6) password and per-user access lists, (7) reconciling a list of resource names against the account.

heyzine_api_key.title: Heyzine API Key
heyzine_api_key.description: The API key from heyzine.com/developers#apikey. Optional - the config file ~/.config/heyzine-plugin/config.toml (unattended default), a 1Password reference, or OAuth sign-in can supply it instead. See /heyzine:setup.

heyzine_key_op_ref.title: 1Password Secret Reference
heyzine_key_op_ref.description: Optional. op://Vault/Item/field pointing at the API key. Read via the op CLI at server start when no direct key is configured. A pointer, not a secret.

heyzine_op_account.title: 1Password Account
heyzine_op_account.description: Optional. Sign-in address (yourteam.1password.com) when the op CLI is signed in to more than one account.

public_host.title: Public Host
public_host.description: Optional. White-label host that serves your flipbooks, for example docs.aflip.in. Share URLs are reported on this host.

template_id.title: Default Template Flipbook
template_id.description: Optional. Id or URL of the flipbook whose design new flipbooks copy.

staging_folder_id.title: Drive Staging Folder
staging_folder_id.description: Optional. Google Drive folder id where source PDFs are staged (anyone-with-link) before conversion.
